source: schema-dist v0.34.1-dist.127 (f50c526), profiles/address.fixture.json: the cases whose name matches /^prose-(start|back-to-back)-/, copied whole and unchanged (14). index counts code points; index_utf16, when present, is the JavaScript string index.

cases.name: prose-start-glued-letter
cases.claim: a letter straight before the prefix glues it into a word: the text is prose, no address starts there

cases.name: prose-start-glued-underscore
cases.claim: an underscore straight before the prefix glues it into a word: no address

cases.name: prose-start-glued-non-ascii-letter
cases.claim: a letter of any script glues: a precomposed e with acute (U+00E9) before the prefix, no address

cases.name: prose-start-glued-combining-mark
cases.claim: a combining mark glues: a combining acute (U+0301) straight before the prefix, no address

cases.name: prose-start-glued-astral-letter
cases.claim: a letter above U+FFFF glues as any letter does: the reader looks one code point back, never one UTF-16 unit (U+1D49C is two units; half of it is not a letter); `index` counts code points, `index_utf16` UTF-16 units

cases.name: prose-start-astral-letter-then-space
cases.claim: a letter above U+FFFF then a space before the prefix: the space glues nothing, so the address starts there; `index` counts code points and `index_utf16` UTF-16 units, and a reader at the wrong unit lands on the space and finds no address

cases.name: prose-start-after-hyphen
cases.claim: a hyphen before the prefix does not glue: the address starts there

cases.name: prose-start-after-digit
cases.claim: a digit before the prefix does not glue: the address starts there

cases.name: prose-start-after-opening-bracket
cases.claim: an opening bracket before the prefix does not glue, and the closing one after the id is prose

cases.name: prose-start-after-quote
cases.claim: a quotation mark before the prefix does not glue, and the closing one after the id is prose

cases.name: prose-start-of-text
cases.claim: the start of the text glues nothing: a line that begins with the prefix holds the address

cases.name: prose-start-glued-letter-site-form
cases.claim: the start rule is the prefix's, both forms: a letter straight before the site's form glues it, no address

cases.name: prose-back-to-back-after-digit
cases.claim: two addresses written back to back: the first id ends in a digit, so the second start is not glued and holds the second address

cases.name: prose-back-to-back-after-hex-letter
cases.claim: two addresses written back to back: the first id ends in a hex letter, a letter, so the second start is glued and holds no address (the first is read at 0 as its own)
